blissey-standard.label: Special wall
blissey-standard.description: Absorbs special attacks, heals with Soft-Boiled, and sets Stealth Rock.

clefable-support.label: Support wall
clefable-support.description: Paralyzes foes with Thunder Wave, removes items with Knock Off, and heals with Soft-Boiled.

clefable-wish.label: Wish support
clefable-wish.description: Passes Wish heals to teammates while chipping foes with Seismic Toss.

dusknoir-offensive-spinblocker.label: Spinblocker
dusknoir-offensive-spinblocker.description: Blocks Rapid Spin to keep your hazards up, and hits back with elemental punches.

gengar-utility.label: Will-O-Wisp attacker
gengar-utility.description: Burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp and stops setup with Taunt while it attacks.

gliscor-stallbreaker.label: Stallbreaker
gliscor-stallbreaker.description: Uses Taunt to stop defensive Pokémon from healing or setting hazards, then wears them down.

hariyama-attacking-lead.label: Fake Out lead
hariyama-attacking-lead.description: Leads with Fake Out for free damage, then hits hard with Close Combat; Flame Orb powers up Guts.

jirachi-utility.label: Wish support
jirachi-utility.description: Passes big Wish heals to teammates and spreads paralysis with Body Slam.

jirachi-wish-protect.label: Wish + Protect
jirachi-wish-protect.description: Heals itself and teammates with Wish, scouts with Protect, and pivots out with U-turn.

rotomheat-utility.label: Bulky pivot
rotomheat-utility.description: Burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp and heals itself with Pain Split.

rotommow-utility.label: Bulky pivot
rotommow-utility.description: Burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp and heals itself with Pain Split.

rotomwash-utility.label: Bulky attacker
rotomwash-utility.description: Takes hits well, heals with Pain Split, and attacks with wide coverage.

starmie-defensive-rapid-spin.label: Spinner (Recover)
starmie-defensive-rapid-spin.description: Clears entry hazards with Rapid Spin and stays healthy with Recover.

starmie-offensive-rapid-spin.label: Spinner (offensive)
starmie-offensive-rapid-spin.description: Clears entry hazards with Rapid Spin while threatening foes with fast coverage moves.

tyranitar-all-purpose.label: Mixed attacker
tyranitar-all-purpose.description: Mixes physical and special attacks, and traps fleeing Ghost and Psychic types with Pursuit.

yanmega-attacking-lead.label: Speed Boost lead
yanmega-attacking-lead.description: Protects on the first turn to gain a Speed Boost, then attacks; Focus Sash lets it survive a hit.
